overclaims: The four-country study ... the reviewed version was available March 16, 2026, after the February 26 claim.
checks.note: The excerpt is verbatim, but it stops mid-quote at “more than 80%”. That drops “no discernable impact ... on either employment or productivity”, so readers may tie the 80% to ROI. The March 16 limitation is misleading: the PDF is dated February 2026, the Hoover page shows Feb 18, and March 16 was picked as a conservative date. Saying it came 'after the claim' wrongly suggests the study postdated Zitron's post. Rationale, outcome and e1 citation hold up. The e2 one-word excerpt 'CFOs' is accurate but thin.
